normalization: For each named literal plaintext field, retain ASCII A-Z only, with no correction. Concatenate k1, k2_as_inscribed, k3 in this order, without separators. Append each absent AZ letter once in AZ order. Treat the resulting string as circular.
scan: forward; current position eligible; next occurrence distance >=0; at most one full circuit
rank: first encounter order of distinct letters; AZ output ranks0..25
transition: advance past first encountered occurrence of selected plaintext letter; modulo reference length
source_only_limits: Table construction and exact static operator comparisons only. No target input read, decoding, fitting, candidate or cipher-message batch. No all-starts target search.
